verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community report that Mixpanel offers group-level/account-level analytics for B2B SaaS, but only on higher-priced plans. That confirms the capability exists, with a plan-gating caveat. None of the first-party docs in the pack describe account-level analysis, and the funnels and retention docs describe only user-level engagement. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of group/account analytics, evidence that funnels and retention can be computed per account or company, how accounts are modeled, and hands-on corroboration.
